_comment: 8d Phase B canonical: teleport-based walkthrough of the two new dungeon maps (dungeon_approach, trapped_halls) -- NEITHER map is reachable from any existing live map this phase (no door edits into either; the M-ARC gallery reopen is B3/controller's own excluded task), so this script is the sole proof they render and work at all, exactly like street_peek/floodplains_peek's own teleport-only precedent, but a real CANONICAL (assert-verified, not a screenshot-only utility). Loads cisterns_scout_start (warrior L1 + [Tactician]/[Appraise Foe] already known -- FIXTURE-FIRST POLICY; both new requires_skill:'observe' traps need it) via title Continue, then teleports in. dungeon_approach: a full perimeter lap proves bounds (every edge cell open -- none of the map's obstacles sit on the border), then each of its 3 entities in turn (the gallery-seal anchor, the dormant-guardian foreshadow, and the REAL new door to trapped_halls -- not the excluded gallery-door edit, a brand-new pairing between these two brand-new maps). trapped_halls: all 4 trap classes in turn -- pressure_plate_a's real [Appraise Foe] reveal + its plain-interact trigger (visual_states tint swap, screenshotted), dart_slit_a's 2026-07-10 nudge-then-hotbar-disarm sequence (requires_skill, disarm-only shape), illusory_floor_a's literal PLAYER_BLOCKED bump (the 'floor that isn't' blocking movement with zero new sim -- entity occupancy alone) followed by its own nudge-then-hotbar-reveal, the snare_nest_slot placement-only placeholder's flavor interact, and (8d C3, issue #82) vault_boss_slot's own flavor interact -- the SECOND, closer sighting of the guardian dormant_guardian_marker foreshadowed, still dormant (kind:prop) though the arena/boss DATA it will eventually fight against is real this lane (data/arenas.json's `vault`, the tuned `vault_construct` + `slam`) -- then a real door round-trip back to dungeon_approach. Whole-run negative: combat_started never fires (all three new dormant/placeholder slots carry no LIVE combat trigger yet -- vault_boss_slot's own arena+boss data exists but its skeleton_scene wiring stays kind:prop until C1 lands the quest gate).

steps._comment: == ENTER dungeon_approach via teleport (unreachable any other way this phase) ==
== bounds lap: the full perimeter is clear (no obstacle sits on the border) -- right 15, down 11, left 15, up 11 returns to (0,0) with zero blocked bumps.
== the gallery-seal anchor (1,6) -- the B3 landing cell, currently an inert rubble-choked flavor prop.

payload_contains.text: The stone doesn't budge. Whatever's on the other side stays sealed. For now.

steps._comment: == the dormant guardian foreshadow (8,9) -- the ratified boss pick's vault_construct sprite, dimmed and still.

payload_contains.text: You keep your distance. Whatever wakes it, you would rather not be the one who finds out.

steps._comment: == the REAL new door: dungeon_approach -> trapped_halls (a brand-new pairing between these two brand-new maps, NOT the excluded gallery-door edit).
== TRAP CLASS 1: pressure plate (6,7) -- a real [Appraise Foe] reveal, then a plain interact TRIGGER.

payload_contains.text: One flagstone sits a hair proud of its neighbors, the mortar cracked clean around its edge. Stepping square on it feels like a very bad idea.
The flagstone gives half an inch under your hand. Somewhere close, something CLICKS. Nothing else happens. This time.

steps._comment: == TRAP CLASS 2: dart slit (10,5) -- disarm-only shape. A plain interact with the skill KNOWN reads the 2026-07-10 nudge (never auto-disarms), then the field hotbar performs the real disarm.

payload_contains.text: A narrow slit runs along the wall at knee height, primed and waiting. This wants a careful, deliberate touch, not a shove.
You trace the mechanism with a careful eye, find the catch, and wedge it still. The slit stays dark.

steps._comment: == TRAP CLASS 3: illusory floor (14,7) -- 'floor that isn't', zero new sim (entity occupancy alone blocks movement). A literal walk-into-it proves the bump, then the same nudge-then-hotbar-reveal sequence.

payload_contains.text: The floor ahead looks exactly like the floor behind you. Somehow, that is the part that bothers you.
You look again, and this time you see it: the grain runs the wrong way, and no dust has settled in months. That is not floor. That is a very good painting of floor.

steps._comment: == TRAP CLASS 4: snare (17,8) -- trigger_radius encounter SLOT, placement-only placeholder. Plain flavor interact (no skill gate, no combat data yet).

payload_contains.text: You give the wire a wide berth. Something in the dark past it has not noticed you yet.

steps._comment: == THE VAULT (18,6) -- 8d C3's dormant boss-encounter SLOT, the SECOND, closer sighting of the same guardian dormant_guardian_marker foreshadowed. Detours around snare_nest_slot's own blocked cell (17,8) via row 6, then returns to the (16,8) waypoint the pre-existing exit sequence below already expects.

payload_contains.text: Whatever waits beyond this arch is not ready for you yet, and you are not ready for it. You step back.

steps._comment: == EXIT via the real return door (1,7), landing back at dungeon_approach (13,6) -- one cell west of the outbound door's own (14,6) cell.
Scope guard: none of the three dormant slots (dormant_guardian_marker/snare_nest_slot/vault_boss_slot) carries a LIVE combat trigger yet -- whole-run negative proof, C1's own job to arm the gate.
